newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: KING FOOD BUYS THREE FRANCHISES.
newsitem.headline: KING FOOD BUYS THREE FRANCHISES.

text.p: King Food Holdings said on Tuesday it had bought franchised pub chains Keg and McGinty and franchised restaurant chain Saddles for an undisclosed sum of money.

Keg and McGinty have been bought from Keg Franchising South Africa (Pty) Ltd with effect from May 1, 1997 and Saddles were acquired from Saddles Steak Franchising (Pty) Ltd with effect from March 1, this year.
The new chains bring the total number of King Food's outlets to 208, including Mike's Kitchen, Mike's Pantry, Bimbos and Porterhouse.
King said the acquisitions would make substantial contributions to the net profit for the year ending February 1998.

Had the acqusitions been acquired and held for the 12 months ended August 31, 1996, the estimated annualised earning per share would have increased by 5.6 cents based on the 66,21 million shares in issue at that date, King added.
